zoe: Heads-up — small starter kit oddity: embedding batch ordering flips result ordering in eval harness.
paul: repro? which starter?
zoe: Next.js + LlamaIndex sample in the monorepo. When we call `redwoodClient.embeddings.batch([...])` responses come back unordered -> downstream eval assertions fail.
maya: that sounds like parallel request reordering. Any logs?
zoe: yes, log snippet: 
```
request ids: [a, b, c]
response ids: [b, a, c]
```
paul: which SDK versions? node or python?
zoe: using `@redwood/sdk@0.8.1` (Node) and `redwood==0.7.9` (Python). Python preserves order, Node doesn't.
samir: SDK parity bug then. Quick workaround is to map results by id on the client, but for sample apps and eval harness we need deterministic output.
maya: can we add an option like `preserveOrder` to the JS SDK? e.g., `embeddings.batch(items, { preserveOrder: true })` that reorders responses before returning.
paul: opened an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/789 
devex-bot: issue #789 created by paul — label: sdk, bug, high-prio
zoe: temporary patch in the sample: set `REDWOOD_PRESERVE_ORDER=true` in `.env` and apply a small reorder helper in `api/embed.ts` so evals pass.
paul: note: the retry code path can also cause duplicates if a batch request retries partially — could lead to duplicate vectors in evals. Need to dedupe on id.
zoe: minimal repro steps for eng-ml: 
1) clone `samples/next-llamaindex-monorepo`
2) `yarn && yarn dev`
3) POST `/api/embed` with body `{ "items": [{"id":"a","text":"..."}, {"id":"b","text":"..."}, {"id":"c","text":"..."}] }`
4) observe response ordering mismatch in logs

maya: assigning to @paul and @samir, cc @eng-ml. Let's get a unit in the eval harness to catch regressions.
paul: will add a test that either asserts preserved order or that the harness sorts deterministically before assertions.
samir: I'll draft a PR to add `preserveOrder` to JS SDK with default `true` for parity with Python, and also harden retry dedupe.
zoe: thanks — I'll update the sample README with the workaround and link the issue. PR incoming from me for the sample patch.
paul: preview deploy failed tests, rolling back preview :sweat_smile:
devex-bot: preview deploy for pr/1234 rolled back — reason: ci/tests:eval-harness failed
zoe: sample PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/1234 — contains env note + mapping helper
maya: great, once SDK PR lands we can remove the env workaround, and add an eval integration test. :thumbsup:
zoe: leaving a short note in the devex checklist about ordering assumptions for embeddings.
